metadata.title: MU Stock: Why Micron Should Benefit from Nvidia’s Memory Price Warning<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Micron Stock Is Getting a Boost From Nvidia’s Memory Price Warning
Nvidia thinks the price of memory chips is outrageous—and it’s still willing to pay it. That’s great news for Micron Technology and its peers.
